review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer

Hybrid/remote work is not available at this time. **We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. RIVO is looking for a proactive, technically strong Senior Systems Engineer to join our IT team. In this role, you’ll administer and secure our Microsoft-based infrastructure and Fortinet network environment, spanning Hyper-V servers, Azure cloud infrastructure, a multi-tenant Microsoft 365 and Azure cloud environment, and enterprise network security, while building automation that keeps our team running on reliable, well-managed, and secure technology. If you're looking for an opportunity to leverage your Microsoft cloud expertise, expand your infrastructure and security skills, and contribute to a growing organization that values innovation and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you! Job Description What You'll Do Systems & Infrastructure Administer and maintain Windows Server environments, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy. Support Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive across a multi-tenant environment. Manage identity and access through Entra ID (Azure AD), including MFA, conditional access, and cross-tenant collaboration architecture. Administer Hyper-V virtualization and Azure infrastructure, including virtual networks and site-to-site VPN connectivity. Monitor server, network, and storage performance and backups, and troubleshoot issues proactively. Network & Security Administer and harden Fortinet firewall, switch, and wireless infrastructure (FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiAP), including VPN configuration. Monitor security logs, investigate incidents, and coordinate vendor escalations as needed. Apply security patches, updates, and endpoint protection (Microsoft Defender) across servers and workstations. Support device management and compliance policies through Microsoft Intune, including mobile device management for BYOD. Track and drive remediation of Microsoft Secure Score findings. Follow best practices for data protection, access control, and disaster recovery, including Microsoft 365 backup solutions. Automation & Integration Develop PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API scripts to automate administrative and monitoring tasks. Build and maintain Power Automate workflows to support business process automation. Support SAML/SSO integrations between Entra ID and third-party applications. Application and policy deployment using both Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Defender Operational Support Provide Tier 2/3 support for escalated help desk tickets. Document systems, processes, and procedures for the IT team. Manage user account provisioning/deprovisioning and hardware lifecycle. Collaboration Partner with IT and Security teams on projects and infrastructure upgrades. Assist with vendor management, escalations, and software license management. Qualifications What We Look For 5+ years of experience as a systems administrator in a Windows/Microsoft environment. Hands-on experience with Windows Server, Microsoft Intune, Entra, Microsoft Azure Subcriptions, and Hyper-V virtualization. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (Azure AD) administration, including multi-tenant environments. Hands-on experience administering Fortinet or similar enterprise firewall, switching, and wireless infrastructure. Solid scripting/automation skills, including PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API. Experience with networking fundamentals: switching, routing, VPNs, and firewalls. Experience with backup and disaster recovery tools, including Microsoft 365 backup solutions. Experience investigating and documenting security incidents. Strong problem-solving and critical thinking abilities. Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. Excellent attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills. Microsoft certification (MS-102, AZ-104, or similar) and/or Fortinet NSE certification a plus. Additional Information Company Benefits Childcare & Family Support: Receive up to $5,000 annually in childcare reimbursement to ease the balancing act of work and family & Exclusive access to comprehensive fertility treatment coverage to financially support your family-building journey Stay Fit for Free: Join our FREE weekly group workouts and keep your health and energy levels at their peak Company Events & Social Hours: Enjoy regular happy hours and company-wide events to celebrate achievements and build community with fellow employees Padres Tickets: Catch a Padres game with exclusive access to season long raffle drawings in the RIVO ticket section. Go Padres! Daily Perks: Savor FREE coffee, energy drinks, and snacks – fueling your productivity and satisfaction! Parking & Commute Made Easy: Say goodbye to commuting hassles and high gas prices – enjoy a company-paid parking or MTS pass Dedication Incentives: Opportunity to earn more money with our perfect attendance incentive – your dedication and reliability deserve recognition Generous Time Off: Recharge and live your best life with company paid holidays and PTO each year Comprehensive Health Coverage: Benefit from medical, dental, and vision plans with a 70/30 cost share—because your well-being is our priority Secure Your Future: Take advantage of our 401(k) plan with employer matching to invest in your future with confidence We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you will be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. A reasonable estimate of the salary range for this job is $110,000.00 to $140,000.00. Individual salaries within those ranges take into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to education; experience and training; licensure and certifications; knowledge and skill sets; and other business and organizational needs. RIVO Holdings, LLC is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, citizenship status, disability, age (40 years old or older) and genetic information (including family medical history), past or present military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

review_candidates.title: ICT System Engineer (FR)
review_candidates.description: Description De L'offre D'emploi En tant qu' ICT System Engineer , tu es responsable de la gestion quotidienne de notre infrastructure informatique. Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec tes collègues, les fournisseurs et les partenaires externes afin d'offrir un support optimal aux utilisateurs et de mener à bien les projets. Ensemble, vous veillez à ce que l'environnement informatique interne reste disponible, sécurisé et à jour. Tes Responsabilités Assurer la gestion et la maintenance des environnements Windows Server. Gérer Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD) et Exchange Online. Assurer la maintenance et l'optimisation des plateformes de virtualisation (VMware et/ou Hyper-V). Administrer les composants réseau tels que les switches, firewalls, réseaux Wi-Fi et solutions VPN. Suivre les processus de sauvegarde et de reprise après sinistre (Disaster Recovery). Mettre en place et surveiller les mesures de cybersécurité. Analyser et résoudre les incidents ainsi que les problèmes techniques. Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des projets d'infrastructure informatique. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique. Pré-requis du poste Tu disposes d'un diplôme de l'enseignement supérieur en informatique ou d'une expérience équivalente. Tu possèdes au minimum 4 ans d'expérience pertinente dans le domaine IT. Tu maîtrises le français ou le néerlandais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit (la compréhension de l'autre langue constitue un atout), ainsi que l'anglais. Tu possèdes une expérience dans l'administration et le support de Windows Server 2022/2025, Active Directory, Entra ID, DNS et DHCP. Tu as des connaissances et de l'expérience avec Microsoft 365 (SharePoint Online, Exchange Online, Teams, Intune, etc.). Tu disposes de connaissances de base en réseaux (TCP/IP, gestion basique de switches, VPN client, etc.). Une certification Microsoft 365 et/ou Sécurité constitue un atout. Tu travailles de manière rigoureuse, structurée et orientée solutions, tout en sachant définir les bonnes priorités. Tu es un véritable joueur d'équipe, doté d'un solide esprit d'analyse et tu accordes une grande importance à la sécurité informatique. Tu es capable de travailler de manière autonome et de prendre des initiatives lorsque nécessaire. Tu es disposé(e) à te déplacer occasionnellement vers les autres sites de ZORGI.

review_candidates.title: System Engineer II (Infrastructure)
review_candidates.description: Acuity is seeking a System Engineer II to be responsible for designing, configuring, and maintaining Acuity’s IT systems to ensure performance, security, scalability, and availability. Building on foundational experience, this role takes ownership of system deployments, integrations, and optimizations while collaborating closely with senior engineers, and cross-functional teams. The System Engineer II actively monitors system health, troubleshoots complex issues, implements automation to improve efficiency, and ensures compliance with security and regulatory requirements. In addition, this role contributes to documentation, disaster recovery planning, and continuous improvement initiatives while mentoring junior engineers and providing technical leadership in daily operations. ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES: General System Work Collaborates with senior engineers to design and implement systems that meet performance, scalability, availability, and security requirements. Participates in the integration of new systems and upgrades to existing infrastructure. Ensures system designs meet key requirements for availability, performance, and maintainability. Works closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure systems are aligned with business objectives and meet technical requirements. Participates in system design reviews, offering insights and recommendations based on technical expertise. Performs regular system maintenance tasks such as patch management, updates, and system backups. Ensures systems are properly maintained throughout their lifecycle, managing hardware replacement, software updates, and configuration changes. Contributes to the planning and implementation of system upgrades, ensuring minimal downtime and disruption. System Monitoring and Optimization Actively monitors system health, performance metrics, and system logs, ensuring the systems are operating as expected, identifying areas for improvement, and optimizing configurations to increase system efficiency. Identifies areas for process improvement and suggests solutions to streamline operations and increase reliability. Monitors resource usage of systems to ensure they are sized appropriately and change resource allocation when necessary. Implements automation tools and scripts (e.g., Ansible, PowerShell) to improve system administration tasks and reduce manual intervention. Problem Resolution Troubleshoots complex system issues related to hardware, software, or networking, applying corrective measures to prevent recurrence. Participates in incident response activities, including root cause analysis, resolution, and documentation of issues affecting system availability or performance. Assists junior engineers in solving complex system issues, supporting their development and providing hands-on learning opportunities. review_candidates.title: Network Engineer- Security Services
review_candidates.description: Position Purpose The Network Engineer is the technical co-owner of Baltimore Aircoil Company’s global network. This is a hands-on subject matter expert role responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and lifecycle management of all routing, switching, wireless, firewall, and WAN infrastructure across our corporate offices and manufacturing plants. The ideal candidate is a true network generalist who can architect a global solution in the morning, troubleshoot a plant-floor connectivity issue in the afternoon, and harden a firewall configuration before the day ends. They are equally comfortable working independently on long-term projects and collaborating with global teams to keep the business running. Reports to: Manager of IT Infrastructure, North America Location: On-site at Jessup, MD Key Responsibilities Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Design, implement, and maintain global network architecture across LAN, WAN, WLAN, and data center environments, with primary stacks built on Cisco (routing, switching, wireless) and Cato Networks (SD-WAN/SASE). Serve as the technical lead for all network projects, including site builds, refreshes, migrations, and acquisitions — from initial design through implementation, testing, and documentation. Own day-to-day network operations: monitoring, capacity planning, performance tuning, configuration management, patching, and lifecycle management of all network hardware and software. Configure and manage firewalls, VPNs, ACLs, and network segmentation (including VLANs and OT/IT separation) to support both connectivity and security requirements. Lead network incident response — triage outages, perform root cause analysis, implement permanent fixes, and maintain runbooks and incident playbooks. Partner with manufacturing and controls engineering teams to design, deploy, and support Operational Technology (OT) network infrastructure on the plant floor, applying segmentation and reliability best practices appropriate to industrial environments. Collaborate with the BAC Global Business Services (GBS) team and global network peers on shared standards, remediation of identified gaps, and adherence to enterprise architecture. Support hybrid cloud connectivity, including site-to-cloud and inter-cloud networking for our cloud environments as required. Maintain accurate, up-to-date network documentation: diagrams, IP schemas, circuit inventories, configuration backups, and change records. Participate in disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution for all network-dependent systems. Contribute to internal and Amsted-driven audit and compliance activities by providing evidence, remediating findings, and maintaining controls within the network domain. Mentor junior IT staff and provide technical guidance on networking topics across the broader infrastructure team. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience and certifications will be considered in lieu of a degree. Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive experience as a Network Engineer, Network Architect, or comparable hands-on network role. Deep, hands-on expertise with Cisco routing and switching (IOS / IOS-XE), including Catalyst switches and ISR/ASR routers. Strong working knowledge of enterprise wireless (Cisco Catalyst, Meraki, or Aironet) including controller configuration, RF planning, and troubleshooting. Production experience with SD-WAN, ideally Cato Networks. Equivalent experience with Velocloud, Viptela, Versa, or Silver Peak will be considered. Expert-level understanding of TCP/IP, routing protocols, switching (VLANs, STP, trunking, EtherChannel), and modern network design principles. Hands-on firewall configuration and management experience — rule design, NAT, VPN (site-to-site and remote access), and policy auditing. Experience designing and supporting network segmentation, including VLANs, ACLs, and IT/OT separation in a manufacturing environment. Working knowledge of network monitoring and management platforms (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Cisco DNA Center, Cato Management Application, or similar). Demonstrated experience with network incident response and structured root cause analysis. Familiarity with disaster recovery planning and testing for network infrastructure. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders, plant leadership, and executive audiences. Ability to work independently, prioritize across multiple concurrent projects, and collaborate effectively across global teams and time zones. Willingness to support occasional after-hours change windows and on-call rotation for critical network incidents. Preferred Qualifications Active Cisco certifications: CCNP Enterprise required level of knowledge; CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure strongly preferred. Cato Networks certification (CNSE / Cato Certified SASE Expert) or equivalent vendor-specific SD-WAN/SASE certification. Experience supporting OT networks in a manufacturing environment, including familiarity with the Purdue model, industrial protocols, and coordination with controls/automation engineers. Cloud networking experience in Azure and/or AWS (VNets/VPCs, ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, transit gateways, hybrid routing). Experience with network automation and infrastructure-as-code tools (Ansible, Python scripting, Terraform, Cisco DNA Center, or similar). Familiarity with security frameworks and standards relevant to network controls (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks). Prior experience supporting a global, multi-site enterprise (manufacturing or industrial vertical preferred). Working Conditions On-site role based at the BAC Jessup, MD location. Occasional travel to other BAC sites and manufacturing plants as required for projects, deployments, and incident support. Periodic after-hours and weekend work for change windows, maintenance, and incident response. BAC Hiring Compensation Range $75,300-$129,100 BAC offers a comprehensive benefits package to include medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401k, employee stock ownership plan, and more. Please see additional details on the BAC website at www.Baltimoreaircoil.com. BAC Employees are eligible to participate in an annual bonus incentive program. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor. See job description

review_candidates.title: Lead Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future. The MITRE Corporation’s All-Domain Integration (ADI) Department (N174) partners with the Department of the Air Force to accelerate the delivery of integrated command-and-control capabilities. Through expertise in digital infrastructure, mission engineering, systems integration, systems engineering, network engineering, architecture, modeling and simulation, operational analysis, and artificial intelligence, MITRE provides independent technical leadership supporting advanced operational capabilities. The ADI Department is seeking a Lead Network Engineer to support the Department of the Air Force Command, Control, Communications and Battle Management program. This role will focus on a combination of hands-on network prototyping and integration along with developing and guiding software-defined wide area network (SD-WAN) and cloud architecture solutions. The successful candidate will provide technical leadership to government and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) stakeholders, guide architectures and implementation approaches, and help shape strategic plans and technology roadmaps for resilient network capabilities across classification domains. Roles & Responsibilities: Seeking talented Lead Network Engineer to join our team and leverage expertise in SD-WAN, cloud networks, network security, automation, and infrastructure architecture to address complex technical challenges for a wide range of sponsor organizations. Candidates will contribute to: Network Design: Defining validated designs for networks with details required for implementation Software-Defined / Virtual Networks: Configuring, deploying, testing and validating the latest technologies in software-defined and virtualized networks as well as “traditional” networking Mission Security and Assurance: Conducting cybersecurity risk assessments of proposed and existing designs to evaluate security posture, identify threats and vulnerabilities, and recommend mitigation strategies Network Data Analytics: Designing, implementing, and enhancing network monitoring and data collection capabilities to provide visibility into performance, availability and operational health Tactical and Threat-Informed Networking: Developing solutions for coupling non-traditional, external threat feeds into traditional network routing parameters (i.e., bandwidth, delay, throughput) to better influence communications paths in challenging network environments Lab oversight and administration: Contributing to the stand up, compliance, and upkeep of cross-cutting virtual and physical experimentation environments at both the unclassified and classified level. MITRE Lead Network Engineers contribute to the design, implementation, testing, validation, and modernization of secure, resilient, and scalable network environments spanning LAN/WAN, data center, and tactical operations use cases. Lead Network Engineers will be expected to build trusted advisor relationships with the government sponsors. The role requires strong collaboration, technical rigor, and the ability to translate mission needs into practical engineering solutions. Basic Qualifications: Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years’ experience; or equivalent combination of related education and work experience. Must obtain a DoW 8140 IAT Level II certification (eg. Security+) within 3 months of hire. The candidate will engage in hands-on, mission-driven work. Responsibilities span the full solution lifecycle - from design and prototyping through testing, implementation, and monitoring - across various networking use cases and solutions. The candidate is expected to have some experience in the following: Network Design: Defining designs that enable secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable solutions, including target-state designs operational processes implementation artifacts Software-Defined / Virtual Networks: Some areas of software-defined and virtualized networks, as well as “traditional” networking protocols and concepts, such as the following: SD-WAN IPv4/IPv6 Interior gateway routing protocols (e.g., BGP and SRv6) Kubernetes Network segmentation Mission Security and Assurance: Conducting and providing: Risk assessments Threat and vulnerability identification Mitigation strategy recommendations Cloud Architecture: Recent hands-on familiarity with: Amazon Web Services Microsoft Azure Network Data Analytics: Monitoring, troubleshooting and managing networks using protocols such as: SNMP and / or Syslog NetFlow/IPFIX APIs and dashboards Technical Reporting and Communications: Clearly communicate technical findings, methodologies, and project outcomes through written reports, briefings, and demonstrations to both internal MITRE & external stakeholders. Knowledge Sharing: Actively participate in internal MITRE technical exchange events focused on emerging trends in networking and service management. Must obtain a DoW 8140 IAT Level II certification (eg. Security+) within 3 months of hire. Must have an active Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI U.S. Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance. This position requires a minimum of 3 days a week on-site. Preferred Qualifications: Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Data Science related discipline, or equivalent combination of related education and work experience. Associate level networking/security certification(s) such as a Network+, Security+, CCNA or JNCIA. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Strong communication, presentation, and writing skills The ability to thrive in collaborative and working relationships with people of different backgrounds. Knowledge of, or hands-on experience in: SD-WAN: Hands-on experience with Juniper Secure Session Routers (SSR) and/or Secure Vector Routing (SVR). Network Services: Recent hands-on experience configuring core network and security services (i.e., DHCP, DNS, NTP, Zero Trust, ICAM) and multiple routing protocols (i.e., OSPF, BGP). Virtualization and Continuous Integration: Experience with DevOps paradigms supported by virtualization, containerization, cloud and serverless architectures Software Development and Automation: Experience using languages like Go, C++, Python, and JavaScript. Strong proficiency in scripting and automation using tools and frameworks like Ansible, Terraform, PowerShell, and Bash. Experience with version control systems, particularly Git, for source code management, collaboration, and CI/CD workflow integration. Network Data Analytics & Monitoring: Experience collecting, process, and analyze large-scale network data (e.g., logs, flows, telemetry, SNMP, etc.) using tools such as Splunk, Elasticsearch, and Wireshark. Develop dashboards and visualizations to monitor network performance, capacity, and anomalies using Grafana, Kibana, and Microsoft Power BI. Implement data pipelines for real-time and batch network analytics using Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Logstash, and Apache NiFi. Tactical and Thread-Informed Networking: Experience integrating distributed and centralized network control algorithms and / or integrating external inputs to “traditional” network path decision logic to facilitate non-standard (i.e., not “shortest path first”) routing. Network Modeling, Simulation and Analysis: Experience with network simulation, emulation, and test methodologies to validate design assumptions and predict performance. This requisition requires the candidate to have a minimum of the following clearance(s): Secret This requisition requires the hired candidate to have or obtain, within one year from the date of hire, the following clearance(s): Top Secret/SCI Salary compensation range and midpoint: $147,200 - $184,000 - $220,800 Annual Work Location Type: Onsite It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Commitment to Non-Discrimination All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local or international law. MITRE intends to maintain a website that is fully accessible to all individuals. If you are unable to search or apply for jobs and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of MITRE’s employment process, please email recruitinghelp@mitre.org for general support and collegerecruiting@mitre.org for intern positions. This service is for individuals requiring reasonable accommodation requests. Please note that vendor solicitations will not receive a reply. Benefits information may be found here. NYC Department of Finance (DOF) is responsible for administering the tax revenue laws of the city fairly, efficiently, and transparently to instill public confidence and encourage compliance while providing exceptional customer service. FIT delivers and administers tax-related payment programs for the City of New York by providing the information technology solutions needed to achieve its mission of collecting revenue while ensuring an efficient and improved customer experience. FIT is also responsible for the systems and websites which enable citywide payments, land records, property assessment, parking adjudications, customer service, and the Sheriff’s public safety work. Responsibilities FIT’s Network and VOIP support team is responsible for all aspects of the network connectivity for the agency, which is comprised of 11 sites, 300+ servers that are responsible for $300+B in tax revenues, keeping the systems operational within the 5 business centers and multiple public-facing websites. The Network & VoIP Team is seeking a Network Systems Administrator. Reporting to the Director of Network/VOIP Infrastructure, the selected candidate’s duties and responsibilities will include, but not be limited to the following: Develop dashboards and network maps (as it relates to management network platforms) for a quick snapshot into the real-time connectivity of all DOF's Cisco switching and routing network devices. Ensure that the DOF network is readily available to the users to perform their daily functions and provide quick resolution to user access issues. Install various Cisco Catalyst 9400, 4500, 3800 series access switches (that connect to DOF's core Nexus 9500 series switches), in DOF's wire rooms to provide LAN/WAN access to all DOF applications to end users moving into a newly created LAN segment. Configure Cisco network access switches (that connect to DOF's core Nexus 9500 Cisco series switches), to provide LAN/WAN access to all DOF applications to existing users on a LAN segment and move new users into a newly created LAN segment. Configure core routers & switches that connect to OTI’s CityNet. Design and create new VLAN subnets on DOF's access and core Cisco switches, to provide LAN/WAN access to special units. Troubleshoot and resolve all LAN/WAN DOF connectivity issues as they relate to IP, redundancy, EIGRP, RIP and RIPv2, OSPF, VLANs, cabling, printing, and security, and the OTI cloud. Develop and implement advanced network management programs and services in support of DOF’s Wide Area Network. Troubleshoot VoIP related issues. May liaise with vendors for technical support. Diagnose Network connectivity problems and communicate technical issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Perform related work of a highly complex, technical nature in LAN/WAN Network design. Provide 4th level technical support to both DOF and OTI. Education may be substituted for experience on the basis that 30 undergraduate semester credits from an accredited college is equivalent to 6 months of experience. However, all candidates must have at least one year of satisfactory (not classroom based) full-time information technology experience as described in "1" above. I en miljö präglad av stort kundfokus och frihet under ansvar blir det extra viktigt för oss att bygga starka team bestående av ödmjuka stjärnor. Att arbeta i en inkluderande miljö, med kollegor och kunder som vill utvecklas, ger oss möjligheten att trivas och ha riktigt roligt på jobbet. Vi tror på en platt organisation med agilt arbetssätt och flexibilitet. Detta är det enda sättet för en hållbar framtid. Advaniagruppen levererar tjänster till kunder i Sverige, Norge, Storbritannien, Island, Finland och Danmark inom hållbar och säker digitalisering.

You will work within a team of cybersecurity professionals to assist with providing that effective security measures are in place. JOB SUMMARY: As a Firewall Operations Solution Architect/Network Sensing Analyst, you will be responsible for the deployment, configuration, and management of firewall and network sensing solutions to maintain optimal performance and security across client environments. The primary purpose of this role is to provide operational coverage, assisting with change requests and supporting problem resolution to uphold the integrity of client networks. You will actively monitor network traffic, analyze security events, and respond to incidents to mitigate risks effectively. Additionally, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance the overall network security posture, complying with industry standards and best practices. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Configure, manage, and optimize firewall solutions to establish effective security controls. Monitor network traffic and security events to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities. Conduct thorough analysis of security incidents, including root cause analysis and remediation efforts. Collaborate with incident response teams to investigate and respond to security incidents in a timely manner. Develop and maintain firewall policies, rules, and documentation to align with best practices and compliance requirements. Provide support for security audits and assessments, promoting adherence to security standards and policies. Stay current with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and security technologies to enhance the organization's security posture. Assist in the development and implementation of security awareness training for staff regarding firewall operations and network security best practices. Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on firewall management and incident response processes. QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field preferred. 5+ years of experience in network security operations, with a focus on firewall management. Hands-on experience with firewall products is required. Strong understanding of network protocols, security principles, and best practices. Experience with technologies such as Checkpoint and Tufin Experience with security monitoring tools such as Splunk and familiarity with network visibility solutions like Netography. Familiarity with ITIL processes and ticketing systems for incident management. Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+) are a plus. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Våra HPC- och AI-plattformar hjälper teknikintensiva organisationer att simulera, analysera, träna och utveckla snabbare och mer hållbart. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och bygga nästa generation av de miljöerna. Det här blir du en del av Du Blir En Del Av Gompute, Advanias Specialistteam Inom High Performance Computing. Vi Bygger Och Driftar Plattformarna Själva, Från Bare Metal Och Nätverk Till Kubernetes, GPU-kluster Och Infrastrukturen Bakom Advanias AI-satsning ALT. Det Innebär Att Du Kommer Nära Flera Delar Av Den Tekniska Miljön, Till Exempel OpenStack med Kolla/Kayobe, Ceph och OVN. Bare metal-provisionering med Puppet och Foreman. Kubernetes-kluster för AI och HPC, exempelvis RKE2 och OKD. Infrastructure as Code med Terraform, Ansible och GitOps. Höghastighetsnätverk, distribuerad lagring och observability med verktyg som Prometheus, Grafana och Loki. Din vardag I rollen får du arbeta brett över hela infrastrukturen, från daglig drift och avancerad felsökning till utveckling, automation och tekniska designbeslut. Du förväntas ta ansvar för tekniska frågor hela vägen från analys till hållbar lösning, oavsett om det handlar om Linux, OpenStack, Kubernetes, nätverk, lagring eller tjänstelager. Du arbetar nära tekniken, automatiserar installation och livscykelhantering med verktyg som Terraform, Ansible och Puppet, och är med och vidareutvecklar miljöerna framåt. Din erfarenhet och tekniska grund Du har stark praktisk erfarenhet av Linuxbaserade miljöer och kan självständigt drifta, analysera och felsöka system i komplexa sammanhang. Har du arbetat med RHEL eller Rocky Linux är det ett plus, men erfarenhet av Ubuntu är också mycket relevant. Utöver det tror vi att du känner igen dig i flera av dessa områden: OpenStack eller annan private cloud-plattform Kubernetes, exempelvis RKE2, OKD/OpenShift eller motsvarande Terraform, Ansible, Puppet och Infrastructure as Code Ceph, parallella filsystem eller andra distribuerade lagringsplattformar Nätverk och datacenterinfrastruktur, gärna BGP, VLAN eller InfiniBand GPU-beräkning, AI-infrastruktur, Bash eller Python för automation Monitorering och logghantering, exempelvis Prometheus, Grafana och Loki Erfarenhet från HPC är meriterande men inget krav. Har du byggt och felsökt avancerad Linux-, cloud- eller infrastrukturmiljö i ett annat sammanhang står du på en stark grund. Du kommunicerar professionellt på engelska och trivs med att ta ansvar, prioritera och driva tekniska frågor framåt. Varför det här är en rolig roll Det här är en roll för dig som vill arbeta nära tekniken och se dina lösningar bli verklighet. Du får kombinera drift, automation, utveckling och arkitektur i miljöer med GPU-kluster, InfiniBand, storskalig lagring och avancerad Linux- och HPC-infrastruktur. Här arbetar du tillsammans med erfarna specialister i en kultur där teknisk nyfikenhet, kunskapsdelning och ständig förbättring är en naturlig del av vardagen. Om Gompute Gompute är Advanias specialistverksamhet inom High Performance Computing. Vi utvecklar, bygger och driftar avancerade HPC- och AI-plattformar för organisationer som vill korta utvecklingscykler, förbättra produktkvalitet och accelerera innovation genom simulering, analys och storskalig beräkning. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! 👋 Visa gärna ditt intresse så snart som möjligt då vi intervjuar löpande. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och synsätt, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och stärker såväl effektivitet som kreativitet i vårt arbete. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en obligatorisk bakgrundskontroll, en för oss kvalitativ kontroll inför ett anställningsbeslut. Advania samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg i ärenden kopplat till alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad "Proaktiv Arbetsplats". Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor eller funderingar.☀️ Det är du som arbetar nära kunden som vet vad dem behöver och vad som blir den bästa lösningen för just deras unika behov, både i dag och i morgon. Därför tycker vi att det är du som ska fatta besluten. Det är genom att erbjuda säkra, hållbara och kundanpassade lösningar som vi skapar värde för kunderna och samhället i stort. Vi bryr oss om hur våra medarbetare mår – på riktigt.
